description: Get Detailed Sales List. Part of the Details APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

type.description: Voucher or entity type discriminator for the list. Mandatory.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 50. Optional.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: date. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

salesPersonUniqueNames.description: Array of sales person unique names values. Optional.
